newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's confirms Yamaichi Baa3 senior debt rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's confirms Yamaichi Baa3 senior debt rating.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service confirmed on Wednesday the Baa3 senior debt and Prime-3 short-term ratings of Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd and its subsidiaries.
The rating action followed the Japanese securities firm's announcement that it would provide 150 billion yen in financial support to its Yamaichi Finance unit, Moody's said in a statement.

"Yamaichi Securities' ratings have incorporated the expectation of substantial losses related to its affiliate, and noted that the size of the announced bail-out package was within the anticipated range," Moody's said.
The firm's capital adequacy, although weakened by its real estate exposure, remains adequate, Moody's added.

"Yamaichi's status as one of the 'Big Four' securities firms is an important consideration in the rating of the company, given the likelihood that Japanese authorities would be supportive of the entity in the event of market disruptions," Moody's said.
